summary: 1935 CCC-era 14x14 cab on a 30-ft steel tower on Estelle Mountain; moved about 1958 to Hemet-Ryan Air Attack Base, where it now works as a control tower.

facts.design: 14x14 cab with catwalk on a 30-ft steel tower
facts.status_note: Standing at Hemet-Ryan Air Attack Base since about 1958. The original Estelle Mountain site has no tower.

staffing.status: not staffed as a fire lookout; used as the air base's ground control tower

access.note: Located at Hemet-Ryan Air Attack Base, a working air base. The sources do not describe public access.

visit.trail_note: The sources describe the tower at an air base and do not describe a public visiting route.

events.note: Constructed on Estelle Mountain by the California Division of Forestry and the CCC.
An October 23, 1936 California Ranger item, quoted by Forest Lookouts, says a Forest Service lookout hosted about twenty Scouts in the tower.
A November 20, 1936 California Ranger item says the lookout spotted a fire eight miles away and sent a crew to a bonfire at that spot.
Moved from Estelle Mountain to Hemet-Ryan Air Attack Base. NHLR says about 1958, FFLA says before 1960, and the marker and Peakbagging say 1958.
Date registered on the National Historic Lookout Register: December 16, 2008.

corrections.why: The record's note says the tower moved, so 'None relocated' contradicts it. NHLR says it moved about 1958.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says about 1958, the marker and Peakbagging say 1958, and FFLA says before 1960. The story gives the range and treats 1958 as the most likely year.
NHLR calls it a 14’x14’ C-3 cab; FFLA calls it a BC-301, 14 x 14 foot design. Both give a 14-by-14 cab on a 30-ft steel tower. The story gives only the size and tower height.
FFLA calls the site the Lake Mathews Estelle Mountain Preserve. Peakbagging calls it an Ecological Reserve. The story says it is a preserve and does not pick a designation.

notes_for_editor: Built, design, move and registration are well supported. The move year varies by source: about 1958, 1958, or before 1960. The 1936 items are newsletter excerpts quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not checked. The 1935 construction credit differs slightly (California Division of Forestry plus CCC on NHLR, CCC alone on FFLA). The brief's 'None relocated' event is contradicted by its own note, hence the correction. Height_m is the 30 ft tower height, not overall height. No current access policy was found. Photos were not added.
